## A custom CA for your pump.fun coin

Your coin's contract address (CA) is its mint address, the one people paste to find and buy it. pump.fun makes a random one ending in `pump`. We grind one that starts with your word instead, like `Degen…`, or starts and ends the way you pick, like `HoLy…Shit`. Then you launch it on pump.fun, right here, and holders can [tell it from a vamp](https://notrandom.fun/stop-vamps/) at a glance.

## From word to live coin

1. **Pick how your CA starts and ends.** The price in SOL and the time estimate update as you type.
2. **Pay in SOL.** Your browser checks the payment before your wallet sees it.
3. **Set up your coin while we grind.** Image, name, ticker, socials and an optional dev buy. Pair it with $NTRNDM to [set your own creator rewards, up to 3%](https://notrandom.fun/creator-rewards/). Your draft survives a reload. On a long search, [get notified when your CA is ready](https://notrandom.fun/notify-when-ready/).
4. **Launch with one approval.** Review the whole package, approve once in your wallet, and your coin is live on pump.fun with your CA. It joins [the leaderboard](https://notrandom.fun/leaderboard/) as soon as it's live.

The full walkthrough, including other ways to do it: [how to get a custom CA on pump.fun](https://notrandom.fun/pump-fun-custom-ca/). First coin? Read [how to create a coin on pump.fun](https://notrandom.fun/how-to-launch-on-pump-fun/).

[See every coin on the leaderboard](https://notrandom.fun/leaderboard/)

## How long does a custom CA take?

Each extra letter makes a match about 58 times rarer. These are the average number of keys it takes to find each example:

| CA | Capitalization | Keys on average |
| --- | --- | --- |
| …pump | Any | 707 thousand |
| …pump | Exact, like pump.fun's | 11.3 million |
| Moon… | Exact | 195 million |
| NTRNDM… | Exact | 656 billion |
| HoLy…Shit | Exact | 37 trillion |

Exact odds for Solana's address format, from the same math as our quotes.

**Want it faster and cheaper?** Keep the ending short or let any capitalization match. Put the part that starts with a capital A to H first: `Based…moon` is much faster to find than `moon…Based`, and the form offers the swap as you type. Grinding a CA yourself? Here's [how long solana-keygen grind takes](https://notrandom.fun/solana-keygen-grind/) for your word.

## Your launch, checked by your browser

Our API builds the pump.fun transaction, and your browser rebuilds it on its own and accepts only that exact launch: you're the creator, the only buy is the dev buy you chose, its tokens go to your wallet, and the fees go to pump.fun's own accounts. Anything else, it refuses. More on [how we protect your key and your launch](https://notrandom.fun/is-this-safe/).

## Questions

Can I launch my custom CA on pump.fun's own site?

pump.fun's create page picks the address for you. Launch right here instead: you set up your coin while we grind, then approve once in your wallet. You can also download the mint keypair for another launch tool that accepts one.

Can my CA end in pump like other pump.fun coins?

Yes. Type `pump` as the ending, alone or after your word, like `Degen…pump`. An ending costs about the same as extra letters, and the price shows the difference as you type.

Does a custom CA change how my coin works?

No. It's a normal pump.fun coin on pump.fun's own program, with the same bonding curve, fees and rules. Only the address is yours.

How much does a custom pump.fun CA cost?

You see the exact price in SOL as you type, and it's fixed when you order. Launching costs what it always costs on pump.fun: the network fee, account rent and any dev buy you choose.

Can anyone else launch a coin with my CA?

Only someone holding the mint key, and only before your coin exists. We encrypt the key to your browser, and you launch soon after it lands. Once your coin is live, the key can't change it.

## Questions, briefly.

What am I buying?+

A fixed amount of API credit. Enter the value of credits you want, then review the discounted price and platform fee. For example, $100 in credits gives you $100 of model usage through your Orbio key.

How is the platform fee calculated?+

The platform fee is 5% of the discounted credit price. The purchase card shows the credit price, fee and total separately, along with your discount after the fee.

Where does the discount come from?+

From Orbio holders who offer unused credit at a discount.

Am I getting the real model?+

Yes. Orbio is a relay: your request goes to the model you named, unchanged, and the response comes back with the provider’s own model name and id on it. Nothing is substituted or downgraded.

Do you store my prompts?+

No. The gateway keeps billing metadata only: the model, the token counts, the cost and the timing of each request. Prompts and responses pass through and are not written anywhere.

Whose key serves my requests?+

Requests use Orbio’s managed OpenRouter account through the Orbio Gateway. You use your own Orbio API key.

What do I change in my code?+

The base URL and the key. Model names, streaming, tool calls and vision work as they do today.

Is there a subscription or a minimum?+

No subscription. Choose at least $5 in credits. Purchased credits become API balance, which you spend as you use your Orbio key.

What does Orbio add to each request?+

Your account page shows the measured gateway overhead for your requests.

Can I get my money back?+

Credit is a grant of product access and is not redeemable for cash. If a card payment goes wrong, reply to the receipt and it is refunded through the card processor.
